title: Explore the Waters of Key West
blurb:
Explore the vibrant & diverse underwater world of the Florida Keys with Salty Paws' Reef Snorkel Trip! Our experienced & knowledgeable crew will take you on a journey to the best snorkeling sites in the area, where you will witness breathtaking views of colorful coral reefs, tropical fish, and other marine life all of which call the reef home.

Our Reef Snorkel Trip is perfect for both beginners & experienced snorkelers. Our crew will provide you with snorkeling gear and give you a safety briefing before entering the water. You'll be amazed at the sights you'll see and the memories you'll make during this once in a lifetime experience.

During the trip, our experienced captains will take you to some of the most stunning locations around the reef where you can snorkel among the vibrant coral formations and observe an incredible range of marine creatures, including colorful fish, sea turtles, and even dolphins. All of which call the reef home.
